requirements.notes: The request does not name a role, so 'React Developer' is inferred from the skill mentioned. '3+ years experience' could mean three years with React or three years of experience overall; I read it as 3+ years of React, which is what a recruiter most likely means. Because the years cover having the skill, React is not listed separately.
